fusions.name: Knuckle Pounce
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and land on it knuckles first, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drumming Bluff
fusions.desc: Beats your chest and lashes out, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Branch to Branch
fusions.desc: Swings you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Goading Grin
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
